detail.longDescription:
ShareKaro makes it easy to share files with people nearby. Send photos, videos, apps, music, and documents without an internet connection. Found something worth sharing? Share it with friends and family in just a few steps.

More than file sharing, ShareKaro brings casual games, file management, and download tools together in one app. Share it with friends, then jump into fun offline games—play while your files transfer or enjoy a quick break, no internet needed. Organize your files and keep your favorite content within easy reach.

🚀 #1 Offline File Transfer
Experience the fastest way to share. ShareKaro is 300x faster than Bluetooth and needs no mobile data or Wi-Fi. 
• No Size Limits: Send huge videos, full apps, folders, and more. 
• Absolutely Offline: Uses peer-to-peer technology for total independence. 
• QR Code Connection: One quick scan to connect and send. 
• Resume Interrupted Transfers: Never lose progress. 
• Zero Login Required: Just download and start sharing.

🎮 Exclusive Offline Games 
Now, turn waiting time into fun time! While your files are transferring or when you have no connection, dive into our collection of quick, HTML5-based games. No data needed, ever. 
• Play instantly, no extra downloads 
• A variety of fun, lightweight games 
• The perfect way to beat boredom offline

📁 Powerful File Manager
Take full control of your phone's storage. Clean up junk, find files instantly, and free up space with ease. 
• Analyze storage and identify unused files 
• Easy browsing and powerful search 
• Keep your device organized and efficient

💾 All-in-One Social Media Downloader
Save your favorite content directly to your gallery! Our downloader feature combines the power of: 
• WhatsApp Status Saver: Download any status image or video. 
• Instagram Downloader: Save photos, videos, stories, reels, and IGTV posts from Instagram and Instagram Lite. It's the perfect, simple tool for saving memories.

Warm Reminds:
Share Karo is mainly focused on nearby files transfer. 
To discover nearby users and share files more efficiently, Share Karo need some permissions such as location, storage, camera etc. 

Please be assured that the permissions we asked are used for file transfer/file share ONLY. 
 
If you meet any problem, please feel free to contact us at: glets724@gmail.com
